thread:
maria.cho: Quick follow-up from yesterday's RFC — we need to lock down runtime rollout controls for the kernel/attention changes before next week's canary. Can we align on per-model enablement order + fallback priority? @devon @aj

devon.k: +1 on per-model. Quick design question: do we evaluate policy rules per-request or on config refresh? Per-request gives finer control but adds eval latency.

aj: prefer refresh-only unless model is marked experimental. refresh interval 30s? also want an emergency override switch.

samir: Telemetry needs: `kernel_switch_count`, `fallback_triggered`, `latency_p50`, `latency_p95`, and `quality_regressions` tied to an eval prompt set. If we do per-request add `policy_eval_time`.

lee: Proposed rollout config (pseudo-yaml):
```yaml
model: redwood-llama-v2
rollout:
  enabled: true
  mode: canary
  canary_percent: 5
  refresh_interval_secs: 60
  emergency_override: true
  policies:
    - name: region_priority
      order: [us-west, us-east, eu-central]
    - name: cost_threshold
      max_cost_per_token: 0.0008
  fallbacks:
    priority: [attn-opt-v3, attn-compat-v2, cpu-safe]
  safety:
    quality_regression_threshold: 0.02
    auto_rollback_window_secs: 3600
  compatibility:
    kv_cache_compatibility: true
    grace_period_tokens: 64
```

devon.k: looks good. Suggest explicitly adding `grace_period_tokens` and `kv_cache_compatibility` (see above) so we don't break long-context sessions mid-switch. Also clarify how prefix/KV cache is migrated between kernels.

maria.cho: Agree. Also we should auto-rollback if `quality_regressions` > 0.02 for 1h and surface rollback reason in request logs/trace. Add a flag to force fallback in-prop for safety.

ops-bot: canary-started: model=redwood-llama-v2 kernel=attn-opt-v3 canary=5% ts=1951240500

aj: :thumbsup: I'll wire the policy refresh path into the admin console and add an "emergency rollback" UI toggle (must be RBAC-protected).

samir: I'll build dashboards for the metrics above + a runbook to action on regressions. I'll also add a synthetic eval job for the canary set. Ping me if you want the prompt set.

maria.cho: Thanks all — locking kernel selection changes until rollout-policy PR is merged. I'll open the PR, tag reviewers, and include the YAML above as the canonical example.
